# truenas_dataset_promote (Action)

Promotes a cloned dataset (pool.dataset.promote) so it no longer depends on its origin snapshot.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Full path of the cloned dataset to promote, e.g. "tank/clone".
